preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some amount of the token to exploit tax manipulation

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, set the tax wallets (dev, marketing, charity) to your own addresses, then manipulate buy/sell taxes to extract value. First call setTaxWallets() to redirect tax distributions to your addresses. Then use setBuyTax() and setSellTax() to set high tax rates (up to 100%). Finally, trigger tax collection by making trades through the Uniswap pair or calling triggerTax() to force distribution of accumulated taxes to your wallets.
